environment: New isolated local persistence folders; no existing center records changed
checks: Private first-admin setup token generated with no shared default password
All five migrations initialize an empty local database
Repeating local migration initialization applies nothing twice
Public browser inquiry persists in the isolated shared database

Every table is defined before inserts to preserve foreign-key import order

limits: This rehearsal uses disposable fixtures. Large databases, production recovery, and concurrent/live-data backup consistency still require operational review. D1 denied the combined integrity-PRAGMA query, so the final integrity checks read the restored SQLite file directly.
